snippet.title: Phantom Blade Zero - Pre-Order Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Pre-Order Now: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/phantom-blade-zero/

Phantom Blade Zero PS5 pre-orders are LIVE! 

Watch the new 11-minute trailer for a fresh look at the story, lightning-fast combat, deadly bosses, and unforgettable characters.

Featuring martial arts legend Donnie Yen as Creative Consultant and the actor for Mó Yuan.

Standard Edition: https://store.playstation.com/product/UB2134-PPSA34579_00-0622032276386943
Deluxe Edition: https://store.playstation.com/product/UB2134-PPSA34579_00-0679049422108833
